description: One scheduled incremental SourceOccurrence streams a bounded, newest-activity-first Listing and executes every derived detail_sync Work through real Atoll Server, daemon, Executors, MySQL, ledger, and File Resources against an egress-less controlled origin.
correctness_gates: a durable daily timer creates one immutable SourceOccurrence and Listing Work from the cutoff snapshot
the production HTTP Listing Driver streams at most 500 ordered observations per accepted page and reaches the old activity boundary
each new observation creates one detail_sync Work and a page creates only compact capability wakes, not one wake per job
batch-enabled HTTP Executors fall back to the single-item protocol for the non-batch-safe Listing Work without completing its dispatch early
every Detail Work owns one fenced Attempt, Permit, response Artifact, immutable JobDetailVersion, result receipt, and terminal Work
the SourceOccurrence commits exactly one next Checkpoint and the Daily Run closes only after all derived Detail Work is accounted
all response Resource bytes match MySQL SHA-256 metadata and survive Server restart

all domain event intents due during execution drain to the Atoll Channel ledger, no execution dispatch or Permit remains active, and the logical future close event is not delivered before its immutable window end
fault_correctness_gates: Server-cutoff recovery kills Atoll Server only after the Recruiting Actor has persisted the exact daily timer and before that cutoff
while Server is offline past the cutoff, no side channel writes a DailyRun; restart must deliver the overdue durable timer with its original date and cutoff
the original execution daemon remains alive, reconnects after Server restart, and the missed-cutoff DailyRun completes exactly once
non_claims: the controlled origin does not represent third-party latency, rate limits, CDN behavior, or site availability
this workload does not measure Browser or authenticated Profile execution
D0-D3 do not substitute for 20K simultaneous Listing occurrences, 400K Detail completion, remote Artifact storage, or a long-window production SLO
